info.title: 映创 · Iteration 7 Creative Studio API
info.description: Local creative studio. Default secure mode requires authenticated organization membership, CSRF and a non-empty Origin for writes. CORS accepts all origins and echoes the request Origin with credentials enabled. FRONTEND_ORIGIN is only the SSO return destination. Explicit AUTH_MODE=demo is local-only and provides no tenant security. Real model runtime remains fail-closed pending end-to-end cost governance. Local protocol tests are not live quality verification.

voice.description: Explicit voice selection, speech jobs only.

budget_currency.description: Explicit original currency for this execution ceiling. No conversion.

budget_maximum_minor.description: User-confirmed maximum in integer currency minor units. Required with a model configuration choice.

quote_request_sha256.description: Request-bound digest from runtime-quote; required for explicit managed execution.

AlignmentInput.description: 任务只产生建议，不自动修改时间轴；用户应用仍须媒体版本CAS。真实ASR未配置时拒绝，不回退估算。

trim_start.description: 原视频trim_start快照用于版本匹配，不偏移从0开始的配音或cue时间。

text.description: Known transcript required for forced alignment; not inferred from ASR.

timing_basis.description: text-estimate/asr-segments/asr-words等实际时间来源；不把本地分配时长冒充声学识别。

trace_parent.description: Optional server-captured correlation context; never authorization.

transcript.description: Text-only result for mode=transcription. No timestamps; cues is empty and this task cannot be applied as subtitle provenance.

episode_number.description: Omitted means episode 1. Existing receipts retain their original payload.

AlignmentTask.description: 持久建议任务；真实running中断标失败，禁止自动重新POST；结果不自动保存到时间轴。

rate.description: Positive decimal quotation string; never applied to original-currency ledger balances.

secret.description: Optional replacement secret. Never returned. Requires server encryption key; do not include real credentials in examples.

input.description: Business request fields only, without model selection, consent or identity metadata. Uses the operation creation schema.

keyframes.description: Optional local-time keyframes. First time 0, strictly increasing through layer duration. Linear x/y/opacity interpolation with endpoint holding. Width/height remain fixed.

MediaVideoOverlay.description: Ordered image/video layer; last is on top. Rectangle fractions of output canvas; time on final shortened movie. Same-project asset required. Image trim=0; muted layers volume=0. Entire time and rectangle must fit.

PosterLayer.description: Text: 1–300 Unicode characters, at most 9 lines, font_size 12–200, hex color; no asset. Logo: owned project image, empty text. Rectangle must fit canvas. Text clips to rectangle; logo preserves aspect ratio.

title.description: PHOTO maximum90 UTF-16 code units, additionally enforced by server.

caption.description: PHOTO description at most4000 UTF-16 code units; video/export retains2200 limit. Server enforces mode-specific UTF-16 constraints.

media_type.description: Omit for existing video/export intents. PHOTO supports only TikTok direct/draft and uses photo_asset_ids instead of asset_id/export_id.

photo_asset_ids.description: Ordered current-project JPEG asset IDs; actual bytes must decode, be at most1080x1080 and20,000,000bytes. PNG/poster conversion is an explicit separate operation.

photo_cover_index.description: Zero-based selected cover; must be less than photo_asset_ids length.

auto_add_music.description: PHOTO Direct Post only; explicit user choice.

public_media_confirmed.description: Must be true for PHOTO: explicit consent to a scoped public read grant lasting up to65minutes.

handoff_expires_at.description: Public media grant expiration; only Douyin handoff jobs.

photo_asset_ids.description: Ordered current-project JPEG asset IDs; actual bytes must decode, be at most1080x1080 and20,000,000bytes. PNG/poster conversion is an explicit separate operation.

photo_source_key.description: Fingerprint of immutable source bytes; does not grant file access.

photo_grant_id.description: Opaque grant identity, not the signed URL or secret.

photo_actor.description: Actor whose current membership is checked when serving a grant.

handoff_url.description: Explicit user-click App scheme; encrypted expiring media capability. Never persist in browser/logs or launch automatically.

confirmed.description: Explicit consent to resize to fit1080x1080 and flatten transparency to white in a newJPEG; original unchanged.

single_person_confirmed.description: Manual single-person, clear, unobstructed face review. No automated face detection is claimed.

created_by.description: Authenticated user ID; empty only in demo mode.

LibraryReferenceInput.description: Exactly one reference source: project image, or an existing reference from a version of this same library asset. Stored references are independent of source-project lifetime. Library references are accepted only when creating a new version.

uploaded_asset_id.description: Immutable asset created by this upload request, including idempotent replay after later uploads.

episode_timelines.description: Independent episode timelines keyed by episode number 2..999. timeline remains episode 1. At most 120 saved episodes.

SessionCookie.name: studio_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie. Secure by default. Mutations additionally require a non-empty Origin and session X-CSRF-Token; all origins are accepted.
